1238-3478-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
1238-3478-8323-8324.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

2317-5478-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

339-574-647-677.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-647-677.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1661-5078-7292-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-5687--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4247-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

333-2281-4247.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-7692.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4779-6972-7159.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

341-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

821-4616-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

586-1018-2701-5626.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
586-1018-2701-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Skullwinder and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1365-1651-2921-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2921-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

325-2498-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2498-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

997-2577-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4052-5435-6264.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4052-5435-6264.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

1698-3260-3540-5901.notablePrerequisites:
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-5901.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-5901.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

1170-2099-5006--23.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
1170-2099-5006--23.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

914-2617-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least one artifact and/or enchantment.
914-2617-4613-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist token's trigger, creating at least one Treasure token.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
914-2617-4613-5917.notes: If opponents control two or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana. Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using step 1 instead.

2608-3664-4499.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat.

4396-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Shifting Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2292-2867-4840-4871.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer four times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and three Myr tokens.
When Myr Battlesphere and the Myr tokens die, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability and Pitiless Plunderer each trigger four times.
Resolve all Demon of Dark Schemes triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve all Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 four times.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1469-3663-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, creating two token copies of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

1579-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter, adding {C}{C}.
Visionary Augmenter dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Visionary Augmenter from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Visionary Augmenter enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

474-4050-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
The Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector, adding one mana of any color.
Specimen Collector dies, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.
